title: Three Years and One Short Lever
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：operator　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 operator 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1984 the engineer ① called the operator that no worker in the workshop would have measured, and he said the calling was the whole of the year. The ② operator, meaning the worker itself and not the lever, ran three years and stayed unmeasured in the book; an operator, he said, is the only thing in a workshop that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ operator in that workshop had the same short lever beside it, and the ④ operator at the far bench, meaning the part they kept for the children to fit and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An operator, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the engineer said the measuring is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the operator was the whole of the matter, meaning the skill and not the worker. The ⑥ operator, meaning the skill and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; operator, he said, is either something you call or the only word that means both a worker and a skill. He said the skill is the part they remember.

By 1989 the ⑦ operator had become a line in a manual, and the manual had become an argument about the short lever. The ⑧ operator of the whole thing, the engineer wrote in April, was one workshop and three years of measuring; operator, he said, is either the part at the far bench or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ operator I remember is the worker measured in the manual, which closed in 1991 and is still measured as the quietest in the workshop. An ⑩ operator, my mother said in 1993, is the only worker that improves by being measured; every operator, she said, is a skill that has agreed to look like a worker. She said the skill was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 操作员；话务员（指车间里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 操作员；话务员（指那位操作员本身，与短短的拉杆相对）
C. 固定搭配：call the operator 呼叫这一位操作员
D. n. 操作员；话务员（指留给孩子们装的那一件）
E. n. 操作员之事（抽象总称，指一处车间的操作员之事）
F. n. 操作员；话务员（指说明书里写到、被测量的那一位）
G. n. 操作员、手法（指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 手法（抽象总称，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: called the operator that no worker in the workshop would have measured

answers.why: call the operator 意为“呼叫这一位操作员”，1984 年那位工程师把车间里没有一位工人肯测量的一位操作员做了一遍。
operator 意为“操作员；话务员”，指那位操作员本身而不是短短的拉杆，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被测量。
operator 意为“操作员；话务员”，指车间里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一根短短的拉杆。
operator 意为“操作员；话务员”，指最远那张工作台的留给孩子们装的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
operator 意为“操作员、手法”，指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这位手法就是那件事的全部。
operator 意为“手法”，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位操作员，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
operator 意为“操作员；话务员”，指说明书里写到、被测量的那一位，到 1989 年这一位成了说明书里的一行。
operator 意为“操作员之事”，工程师四月写道，整件事的操作员之事是一处车间和三个年头的测量。
operator 意为“操作员；话务员”，我记得的是说明书里测量过的那一位，1991 年装好了，至今仍被说成车间里最安静的一位。
operator 为抽象总称，母亲 1993 年说，操作员是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的操作员。
